name: JobHunt
author: JobHunt
description: See what needs you today in your job search, and your streak, right from the bar.

barWidget.description: One quiet number for the interviews and tasks due today, and a panel with today's items, your streak, your pipeline and hand-offs to your own agent. Needs the JobHunt command line tool and an account at jobhunt.app.

schema.label: Refresh in the background
schema.description: When on, the JobHunt command runs on the interval below and contacts jobhunt.app each time. When off, data loads only when you open the panel or press refresh, and the bar number may be out of date.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the JobHunt command is run in the background (when background refresh is on). It is also run when you open the panel.

schema.label: Hide company names
schema.description: For shared screens. Company names stay out of the panel.

schema.label: Open links
schema.description: Open jobhunt.app in a browser tab, or in a dedicated web app window (needs a Chromium-based default browser).

schema.label: JobHunt command path
schema.description: Optional. Full path to the jobhunt command if it is not found on the shell's PATH.
